BOTH flagging agents explicitly DECLINED to score it. vol-surface: real 07-29 earnings kink at dte=17 (102.5%, thin at n=43) but NOT scored-eligible — no valid VRP anchor (FTAI is Industrials; SPY's FAIR VRP is too diluted/neutral to license a VRP-aligned claim on an unrelated-sector idiosyncratic name). contrarian-scanner: pc-ratio z=9.01 BEARISH_EXTREME (P/C 2.904) is ALIGNED institutional flow, not a lone crowd trade — per Pan-Poteshman (2006) and Ge-Lin-Pearson (2016) single-name put crowding predicts CONTINUATION, so the crowd is more likely RIGHT here; and the -2 line is a LONG-only penalty whose 'VRP positive' precondition is unmet fleet-wide.
The 'oi_building_puts' screen factor does NOT survive the 10-day OI trend: adds are trivial (533-2,364 contracts/day) and CALL-dominant (the 08-21 220C is the largest add).
Its entire 30d options tape is $67.1M gross and the 30d net leans marginally BULLISH against the short.
calls.thesis: Bearish FTAI on the day's highest-scoring bearish confluence screen (score 6, IV rank 94.26, P/C 2.90, volume ratio 3.2). Scored -1 and DROPPED. This is the cleanest demonstration this quarter of why the funnel score is a seed and not a conviction score: both flagging agents declined to score it, the 'oi_building_puts' factor is contradicted by a call-dominant 10-day OI trend, and the 30d net flow leans marginally bullish against the short on a $67M tape — firing flow_conflict_lite.
